verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents passkeys and WebAuthn biometrics as primary login methods alongside email/SMS passwordless (auth0-docs-82, auth0-docs-88, auth0-docs-93). It also documents one-time codes delivered by email or SMS as a password replacement (auth0-docs-34, auth0-docs-51), and lists WebAuthn security keys and biometrics as MFA factors (auth0-docs-38). Missing for 10: explicit magic-link evidence, in-depth configuration docs beyond marketing and overview snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
